MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 3

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 8

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
